text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(As expected, her legs and her passion are in a league of their own.
—Still, this is just a milestone along the way...!)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (Surpass it, surpass it—break through and go beyond!)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, DAAAHHHHH--!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Claiming victory in 1st place in magnificent fashion, Sirius Symboli!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: *pant, gasp*――

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...! Alright...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: DAMMIIIIIIT--!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah, damn it!
I couldn't hold on!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm glad.
It was hot, fierce—an exquisite race.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I'm really looking forward to seeing you shine on the world stage too.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Well, thanks for that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I got to witness top-level racing before my own debut.
...This will serve as great food for thought.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
!
Haha, you sure talk big, Sirius!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
To be left speechless. To have one's gaze stolen away.
To think that you of all people could be made to feel that way.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha. Well, this is embarrassing.
Guess I got a little too carried away."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh my,
covering it up with such clumsy words.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"‘Infatuated’?
Hardly—it's nothing so simple."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Craving... obsession...
Ah—could it be jealousy?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Next will surely be the Arima Kinen.
Can you wait until then?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I won't be running.
It wasn't a half-hearted resolve that led me to this decision.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Be on your guard.
The most exquisite love is often the quickest to vanish.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
............
――Well, this is troubling.

That day's Japan Cup became a massive topic of discussion,
and the winner Sirius Symboli's fame skyrocketed just as planned.
And then, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: URA Programming Representative
text_block_list.text: Sirius's overseas challenge has been officially confirmed!

The two-year overseas expedition plan
that I had been scheming with Symboli Rudolf
has finally been approved!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Naturally.
...If anything, they took their time.

text_block_list.name: URA Programming Representative
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry that turned into such an argument!
I'm glad it worked out, though.

text_block_list.name: URA Programming Representative
text_block_list.text:
Just as Sirius-san said...
All the opposition disappeared in the face of her race results—

text_block_list.name: URA Programming Representative
text_block_list.text: "The recent Japan Cup was the absolute deciding factor!"

text_block_list.name: URA Official with Black Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Putting on a race like that
against Ace and CB...
You can't help but acknowledge her talent.

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
............
I'm in favor of taking on overseas challenges.

text_block_list.name: URA Programming Representative
text_block_list.text: Seriously, I can only say you're amazing!
—The overseas campaign will start next year. After finishing all the official paperwork, the two of us returned to the academy.

With everything going far smoother than imagined,
a smile unconsciously spilled over.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Wipe that smirk off your face. Look at yourself, it's pathetic.
What Sirius Symboli boldly declared at the start of the year has been magnificently achieved.

...During the Classic Year,
she lost sight of herself, and a lot happened.

Yet, deep down, she truly was
a strong and dependable Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: You're not even listening. ...Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'm just gonna do a light cool-down and head home. I don't need you babysitting me.
We're done for today.

I tell her that we haven't decided
on our next target race yet.
I thought the year-end Arima Kinen would be fitting as a final domestic race, but—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...The environment here is different from overseas.
Use this period to prepare for your overseas expedition.
choice_data_list: So... does it end with the Japan Cup for now?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: That's how it'll be.

And so, far more effortlessly than expected,
the Twinkle Series came to an end.
A few days later, Sirius Symboli's overseas expedition was announced on campus.

Though it had not yet been officially announced
to the outside world, the news sent shockwaves
through the student body—
(Knock knock knock knock knock knock knock!!)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Come in.

Accompanying a frantic knocking,
the person who burst in was—

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text: Congrats on deciding to go on an overseas expedition, y'all!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Juniors
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!!
It was Sirius Symboli's underclassmen.

All kinds of merchandise and colorful bouquets were carried in one after another.
As always, she is deeply adored by everyone.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
These are the happi coat and banner we all made together
for going overseas! Pretty cool, right?!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
With this, all of us can cheer you on,
so look forward to it, okay!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior B
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There's cake and stuff too, y'know!
Everyone made it together! Can I have some?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Aren't you getting a little too carried away?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Juniors
text_block_list.text: Of course I'm gonna be pumped up~!

Afterward, an impromptu party kicked off,
and in the midst of the boisterous merrymaking, the sun went down in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Juniors
text_block_list.text: Well then, thanks for having me!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief. They're like a hurricane.

text_block_list.name: Timid Junior of Sirius
text_block_list.text: "U-Um...! Sirius-senpai!"

text_block_list.name: Timid Junior of Sirius
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry!
Um, I just really wanted to say it...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: What is the matter?

text_block_list.name: Timid Junior of Sirius
text_block_list.text:
A-Actually, I...
I've always... been interested in going abroad.

text_block_list.name: Timid Junior of Sirius
text_block_list.text:
I want to compete in the outside world and truly shine.
I... I want to be the one to win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe,
a race no one has ever won before...!

text_block_list.name: Timid Junior of Sirius
text_block_list.text:
Still, the more I think about taking on an overseas challenge,
the more I realize how much of it you can't do all alone.

text_block_list.name: Timid Junior of Sirius
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't know what to do.
...I had even given up at times."

text_block_list.name: Timid Junior of Sirius
text_block_list.text:
B-But still! Sirius-senpai is paving the way
and showing us the path forward right now.

text_block_list.name: Timid Junior of Sirius
text_block_list.text:
And that gave me so much hope...!
Like, 'Ah, it's okay. There really is a path to that dream—'

text_block_list.name: Timid Junior of Sirius
text_block_list.text:
I realized... all I have to do
is walk toward that guiding light!

text_block_list.name: Timid Junior of Sirius
text_block_list.text:
S-So, anyway, um, that's how it goes!
Uh, well then! Thanks for your hard work...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ……A "landmark", huh……

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Won't you become a precedent—a monumental milestone,
and illuminate the path for those who follow?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If a path is made, they too can move forward.
There will be no need to kill their dreams.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (Preaching the way is a saint's job. Anyone who can't carve their own path ends right there.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(That's why I've always tuned out her preachiness.
—However...)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
("Just use that light as a guide to walk forward"...
Huh...)

Sirius Symboli looks up at the sky.
Beyond the thin windowpane shines a single, brilliant star.
The next morning.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Forget non-stop training.
Set our sights on the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
…………
...Turns out I'm cut from the exact same cloth.

She didn't say another word
in response to that question.

And so, our days of hard work began
as we aimed for the Arima Kinen, her final domestic race!
